title: Recording: B Side To Seaside by Suzy And The Red Stripes | 1977
content:
Studio Three, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

Paul and Linda McCartney finished recording ‘B Side To Seaside’ on 18 March 1977.

The backing track had been taped on 16 March. During this and the previous day, Paul added bass and percussion parts to complete the recording.
